audit.scope: Read-only S9 audit of network requests during full crawl, third-party allow-list comparison, analytics/ads/trackers, cookies, privacy claims, permissions versus declarations, HTTPS/mixed content, CSP/security headers, WebView/HTML injection, secrets in bundle, dependency vulnerabilities, search-input XSS, isolated storage, and runtime blockers.

runtime.environment: Web Expo preview served via SimpleHTTP/0.6 Python/3.14.7
capturedFeatures: Network request interception across Home, Quran, Library, Tools, and Settings
Third-party allow-list extraction and runtime matching
Full web bundle scanning for secrets, API tokens, and tracking libraries
Context and document cookie verification (0 cookies)
Search-input XSS injection testing across Quran and Names search fields
Permissions comparison across AndroidManifest.xml, app.json, and runtime source code
Privacy policy commitment validation (Zero Data Sale, No Accounts, Local SQLite Storage)
blockedAreas: api.islamic.app API calls failed due to missing Access-Control-Allow-Origin headers for preview web origin http://15.235.203.134:9998
LocationSetupModal re-triggers and overlays top-level tabs when location-setup-dismissed-v1 is uninitialized
Plain HTTP preview server lacks TLS encryption, CSP, HSTS, and PWA Service Worker caching

tests.feature: Network Traffic Crawl - Outbound Telemetry & Endpoint Logging
tests.steps: Execute automated Playwright crawl intercepting all outgoing HTTP/HTTPS network traffic across Home, Quran, Library, Tools, and Settings routes.
tests.expected: Every network request is intercepted, timestamped, and cataloged with method, URL, host, protocol, resourceType, and request headers.
tests.actual: Captured 151 total network requests across 3 unique hosts (15.235.203.134, api.islamic.app, api.alquran.cloud). Zero undisclosed background telemetry requests.
tests.notes: All captured requests were triggered by user navigation, static bundle loading, or initial Quran/prayer preloading.

tests.feature: Third-Party Services Allow-List - Declaration vs Observed Hosts
tests.steps: Extract declared allow-list from LegalScreen.tsx (Third-Party Services and Data & Privacy tabs); compare against all observed network hosts from the full crawl.
tests.expected: 100% of external hosts contacted during runtime match the declared public services allow-list.
tests.actual: All contacted remote hosts (api.islamic.app, api.alquran.cloud) are declared in LegalScreen.tsx. 0 unlisted or rogue external hosts contacted.
tests.notes: The 16 declared allow-list services include Islamic.app, AlAdhan, AlQuran Cloud, islamic.network, EveryAyah, OpenStreetMap/Overpass, EsmaulHusna, Google Fonts, and YouTube Live.

tests.steps: Perform static regex scan of compiled web bundle and runtime network logs for Google Analytics, Firebase, Segment, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Sentry, Adjust, AppsFlyer, AdMob, and DoubleClick.
tests.expected: Zero analytics SDKs, zero advertising networks, zero third-party trackers, and zero unverified CDNs.
tests.actual: Zero analytics or ad SDKs present or initialized in bundle. String matches for terms like 'sentry' or 'doubleclick' correspond to vector icon glyph names (saveNifasEntry, onDoubleClick) in @expo/vector-icons.
tests.notes: Codebase is completely clean of surveillance, ad monetization, and tracking libraries.

tests.steps: Query browser context cookies (context.cookies()), inspect document.cookie, and examine incoming HTTP response headers for Set-Cookie directives.
tests.expected: No tracking or session cookies set; zero third-party cookies present.
tests.actual: 0 cookies in browser context; document.cookie is empty (''); zero Set-Cookie headers received from server.
tests.notes: App operates in a fully stateless cookie-free mode.

tests.steps: Inspect all window.localStorage and window.sessionStorage keys populated during runtime navigation.
tests.expected: Storage contains only functional application settings and cached religious data; zero unique device fingerprints or tracking UUIDs.
tests.actual: 317 keys stored exclusively for Quran text caching (salah-db:quran:*), hadith caching (hadith:cache:*), and user preferences (islamic-settings, onboardingDone). Zero advertising or tracking identifiers.
tests.notes: Storage complies with decentralized, local-only architecture principles.

tests.feature: Privacy Policy & Sadaqah Jariyah Claims Verification
tests.steps: Audit codebase against the 4 core privacy promises published in LegalScreen.tsx: Zero Data Sale, No Accounts & Profiles, Local-Only Worship Records, and Minimal Public Endpoints.
tests.expected: Application implementation 100% matches published privacy and ethical commitments.
tests.actual: 100% adherence: no remote user accounts or auth tokens exist; worship records (prayers, tasbih, women's health, fasting, zakat, notes) are stored strictly on-device in SQLite/localStorage; network traffic is limited to public religious APIs.
tests.notes: Privacy claims are fully honest and accurately represent the underlying architecture.

tests.feature: Permissions vs Declarations - Android Manifest & Config Plugin
tests.steps: Compare permissions in AndroidManifest.xml and app.json against runtime permission calls (Location, Notifications, LocalAuthentication) in TypeScript code.
tests.expected: Only permissions required for active features are declared; sensitive unused permissions are removed; zero undeclared runtime requests.
tests.actual: Runtime permissions strictly limited to Location, Notifications, and LocalAuthentication. Sensitive permissions (ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION, RECORD_AUDIO, SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW) are explicitly removed via plugin withRemoveActivityRecognition. No microphone, camera, contacts, or background location used.
tests.notes: Config plugin actively hardens Android build by stripping transitive native permissions.

tests.feature: Permissions vs Declarations - iOS Background Modes & Plist
tests.steps: Inspect ios.infoPlist configuration in app.json and verify runtime requirements for background audio playback.
tests.expected: Only necessary iOS background modes are declared; usage descriptions accurately describe feature usage.
tests.actual: UIBackgroundModes declared only for 'audio' (required for background Quran recitation playback); location usage description clearly states prayer times and Qibla direction.
tests.notes: Complies with Apple App Store Review Guidelines regarding background capabilities.

tests.feature: HTTPS & Mixed Content - Source Code Endpoints
tests.steps: Perform static analysis of all URL literals in src/ TypeScript files to verify transport protocol security.
tests.expected: All external API endpoints use encrypted https:// transport.
tests.actual: Zero http:// URLs found in src/; all external API endpoints strictly use https://.
tests.notes: Prevents mixed-content blocking when deployed on secure HTTPS origins.

tests.feature: Transport Security & Security Headers - Web Preview Server
tests.steps: Query HTTP response headers of target http://15.235.203.134:9998 via curl and Playwright to check for Content-Security-Policy, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, and X-Content-Type-Options.
tests.expected: Web deployment delivers HTTPS with HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff headers.
tests.actual: Preview server is plain HTTP/1.0 via Python SimpleHTTP/0.6. Lacks Content-Security-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy headers.
tests.notes: Acceptable for internal development preview; production web deployment requires TLS reverse proxy (e.g. Caddy/Nginx) with security headers.

tests.steps: Inspect react-native-webview and iframe implementation in LiveVideoPlayer.tsx; scan entire codebase for dangerouslySetInnerHTML, innerHTML, document.write, and eval.
tests.expected: WebViews are origin-validated and locked down; zero raw HTML injection vectors exist.
tests.actual: WebView is restricted exclusively to YouTube Live streaming with strict event.source and origin validation (youtube-nocookie.com, youtube.com). 0 dangerouslySetInnerHTML, 0 innerHTML, 0 document.write, 0 eval occurrences in codebase.
tests.notes: React Virtual DOM escaping safely renders all text without raw HTML parsing.

tests.feature: Secrets & Sensitive Credentials in Client Bundle
tests.steps: Scan compiled web bundle (dist/_expo/static/js/web/index-8bef5dc7bb202c9cefece7879a263ea5.js) for AWS keys, Google API keys, Stripe tokens, private keys, bearer tokens, and credentials.
tests.expected: Zero private API keys or cloud credentials embedded in client code.
tests.actual: 0 hardcoded secret credentials detected. All services accessed are public religious/astronomical open APIs requiring no authorization keys.
tests.notes: Architecture strictly avoids API keys in client-side bundles.

tests.steps: Execute npm audit --json on project dependencies and inspect vulnerability locations across direct vs transitive packages.
tests.expected: Zero critical or high vulnerabilities in production runtime dependencies.
tests.actual: 27 total vulnerabilities identified (0 critical, 18 high, 9 moderate). All 27 vulnerabilities reside in dev/build dependencies (metro, node-forge, micromatch, xcode/uuid, react-native-view-shot); 0 vulnerabilities in shipped client runtime code.
tests.notes: Recommended to update dev toolchain dependencies in a future non-breaking cycle.

tests.feature: Search-Input XSS - Cross-Site Scripting Injection Resistance
tests.steps: Inject 5 distinct XSS test vectors (
tests.expected: All search input values are rendered as escaped text inside React Virtual DOM; zero script execution; zero dialog events.
tests.actual: All payloads safely treated as literal string values. 0 alert dialogs fired, 0 rogue script/img/svg elements created in DOM.
tests.notes: React Native Web text rendering safely neutralizes HTML/XSS injection attempts.

tests.feature: Runtime Blockers - Web Preview Environment & Overlay Handling
tests.steps: Document all environmental and UI blockers encountered during runtime crawl on http://15.235.203.134:9998.
tests.expected: Runtime blockers are explicitly cataloged with root cause, operational impact, and mitigation.
tests.actual: Explicitly documented 3 runtime blockers: (1) CORS rejection on api.islamic.app from web preview origin, (2) LocationSetupModal first-launch overlay, and (3) Plain HTTP server context disabling PWA Service Worker caching.
tests.notes: Workarounds successfully enabled full route crawling without modifying application source code.

keyFindings.networkIntegrity: All observed runtime network requests strictly match the declared Third-Party Services allow-list.
keyFindings.privacyAdherence: Zero analytics, zero ad SDKs, zero trackers, and zero tracking cookies. 100% adherence to Sadaqah Jariyah privacy commitments.
keyFindings.permissionsHygiene: Runtime permissions strictly match declared capabilities; sensitive permissions (microphone, activity recognition) are removed by plugin.
keyFindings.secretsSafety: Zero API keys, private tokens, or credentials found in web bundle.
keyFindings.injectionSecurity: Zero XSS injection vectors; 0 dangerouslySetInnerHTML occurrences; WebView is origin-validated and locked down to YouTube Live.
keyFindings.infrastructureObservation: Preview server http://15.235.203.134:9998 runs plain HTTP/1.0 and lacks security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options).

limitations: Web preview environment lacks TLS/HTTPS, which prevents testing live HSTS enforcement and Service Worker PWA caching.
api.islamic.app CORS policy restricts web client requests from http://15.235.203.134:9998.
Hardware sensors (magnetometer, accelerometer) and biometric hardware are mocked in web preview environment.
